_comment: sim-robust-collect-arrival-v1 bounded collect-only validation config. Purpose: prove the HONEST (non-ground-truth) collect reaches a tolerance-aware source park and either seals the grasp OR fails fast with a NAMED reason -- never the opaque 90 s WALL arm-command heartbeat ('arm command heartbeat lost', runs 321/327). The integration lane (twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1) schedules it through /tmp/aile-gpu.lock. How to run: `scripts/run_mobile_restock.py ... --stop-after collect` (ends right after the collect/pick stage, so the place-on-cart replan / cuMotion OOM owned by sim-robust-collect-place-v1 is NEVER reached) with RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH UNSET (honest collect, no ground-truth shortcut). Merge the 'grasp_press_timeout_s' key into the mission runtime-config (the host block read by scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host.py). The tolerance-aware source arrival (strict_xy_arrival) needs no config -- runtime.py sets it on the collect source leg automatically (a no-op when no XY hysteresis is configured => byte-identical). Absent 'grasp_press_timeout_s' => the press budget is off (byte-identical); set it to bound the honest grasp-press.
_grasp_press_timeout_s_note: SIM seconds (node/sim clock, render-pacing-safe -- NOT wall). Bounds the WHOLE unconfirmed pre-weld press across the contact descent and the grasp confirm/retry loop; once exceeded with no confirmed held carton the collect FAILS FAST with 'grasp press exceeded <N>s sim without a confirmed held carton ... failing fast before the arm-command heartbeat watchdog'. Clamped in the controller to <= phase_timeout (120 s). A healthy grasp seals in a few sim seconds, so 10 s is comfortably above a legitimate seal yet well inside the 90 s wall heartbeat; tune up only if a genuine slow seal is observed.
_expected_pass: The honest collect either reports collect SUCCEEDED (seal + lift) OR fails with the named 'grasp press exceeded ...' reason and NO 'arm command heartbeat lost' / 'host emergency stop' terminal line; NAV shows arrived_stopped at the source with xy within the grasp tolerance (never a declared arrival outside tol).

_suggested_env.RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH: UNSET (honest collect; do NOT set 1 for this proof)
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_GRASP_RETRY_MAX: optional -- a small bounded re-seat budget (e.g. 2) if a single press flakes; the grasp_press_timeout_s backstop bounds the whole press either way
